# Workforce Coordinator

Do we have enough Officials?
Do we have the right mix of skills in the volunteers?
Do we have who we need to be able to host galas?
Are our volunteers armed with all the infomation and support they need?

Answering all these questions and more falls to the role of the workforce
coordinator.
They hold a key position on the committee, since the club would not exist without
a healthy supply of well prepared volunteers!
